# اِسْتَفْحَلْتَ (istafḥalta) /is.taf.ħal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
# اِسْتَفْحَلْتِ (istafḥalti) /is.taf.ħal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَفْحَلَ (istafḥala)
# اِسْتَفْحَلَتْ (istafḥalat) /is.t
